comments.body:
2026-11-02, 0.20.0, laptop: the first gap bit the person typing in the held pane, not only someone reading `muster window`. A Codex builder helper posted its report to its maker, a Claude Code pane; the wake was held because the maker's prompt held unsent text the person had typed there (by the time they looked it read 'did it get stuck?'). @muster told the builder after two minutes, and the builder decided to wait. Nothing in the maker's pane, where the person was typing, said a message for its agent was waiting, so they took the builder to have stalled. Same again later that session with another report held 2+ minutes. The 'went idle without posting' notice that followed each time is on a_2mSyvanM4.

Possibly: while a wake is held on unsent input, show it where the typist looks, such as a '1 message waiting' badge on the pane's border or header.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

comments.body: 2026-11-13: two of three gaps fixed (muster window shows a held wake and why; a wake whose command is running counts as delivering). Left: a post to another machine's member carries no held reason, until or activity; the peer Posted reply would have to carry all three.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description: Raised 2026-10-16 after a held wake became visible to its sender (a_2hIfuUkdQ). Three gaps left, each minor: muster window does not show a held wake on the pane's row, for a person rather than an agent to see at a glance; a post to another machine's member carries no held reason, like until and activity (a peer Reached would need all three); and a wake whose wake command is running sits in no list, so msg who reads it as rung and not read for those seconds (Codex panes only).
title: A held wake's reason, beyond msg who and the post's answer
